necessary_constructions: A,B,C,D = construct_rectangle_q(15,20), E = construct_on_dia(D,A), E = construct_on_dia(B,C), F = construct_intersection_ll(D,E,B,C)
proof:

5. Collinear(D,E,F) => Parallel(D,E,E,F) & Angle_A_D_E - Angle_A_D_F & Parallel(D,E,D,F)
6. Perpendicular(A,E,D,E) & Parallel(D,E,E,F) => Perpendicular(A,E,E,F)

20. Perpendicular(A,E,D,E) & Parallel(D,E,D,F) => Perpendicular(A,E,D,F)
21. Midpoint(E,D,F) & Perpendicular(A,E,D,F) => Length_A_D - Length_A_F
